mentions.name: Private Equity Vet
mentions.description: A website that lists veterinary practices owned by private equity or large corporations, helping pet owners make more informed decisions about where they take their pets. It compiles practice names from consolidator websites, verifies them, and accepts user submissions; the list now spans the US and UK.
mentions.problem: Pet owners often can't tell whether a vet practice has been acquired by private equity or large corporations, leading to experiences like missed diagnoses, lack of continuity of care, no medical leadership, and predatory billing.
mentions.audience: Pet owners deciding where to take their pets for care.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a website that lists veterinary practices owned by private equity or large corporations to help people make more informed decisions about where they take their pets.
